title: ENCI geological section

source.title: ARCADIS / ENCI B.V. — Kalksteenwinning ENCI tot 2020, Startnotitie

note: Approximate quarry-wide elevation intervals from the 2007 report, not surveyed three-dimensional contacts. Horizontal boundaries assumed for visualisation. Present surface sampled from uploaded terrain. Overburden, spoil, backfill and submerged floor unresolved. Not a geotechnical model. D’n Observant is reported as an overburden depot, not intact natural strata. No fill geometry assigned.

layers.name: Maastricht Formation

layers.name: Cover / disturbed ground
layers.description: Not mapped. ARCADIS (2007) describes original ~15 m loess/sand/gravel cover and partial deposition at D’n Observant; present artificial material thickness and footprint unknown.
